_role: READ-ONLY 24/7 L5 shadow research (issue #167 comment 5574408755 item 5). Separate process and image from the WS evidence recorder, the sports collector, the spring probe, the Gemini shadow and the l5-ops research service. It NEVER writes the frozen model/lookup/spec; it writes proposals that REQUIRE an owner decision.
_credentials: NONE. This service holds no trading credentials, no exchange key, no wallet key and no PMUS_SPRING_* / KALSHI_* / POLYMARKET_* secret. Its only network use is the public, keyless L5 activity endpoint the existing collector (src/polymarket_l5/ops.py SOURCES) already reads. If that collector ever requires a key, the ONLY thing to add here is the env var NAME it documents (none today) -- never a value in this file.
_volume: Mount a dedicated volume at /data/l5_shadow (L5_SHADOW_STATE_DIR). Do NOT reuse /state/pmus-ws (recorder), /state/pmus-sports (collector) or /state/pmus-spring (probe). Everything the loop writes (collector cursor + day files under ops/, heartbeat.json, alarms/, proposals/, tally_latest.json, notes.jsonl, failures/) lives on this volume only.
_pin: Set the service variable RAILWAY_DOCKERFILE_PATH=/deploy/l5_shadow/Dockerfile on this service (deploy/RAILWAY_ISOLATION.md pattern) so a branch push can never cross-build it with another service.
_watch_note: watchPatterns deliberately EXCLUDE src/polymarket_l5/** and every src/pmus_*.py: a change there redeploys the live probe/recorder, and this research service must never be a reason to touch them. It rebuilds only when its own loop, the drift/scoring helpers or this deploy dir change.

_env._note: defaults are baked in src/l5_shadow_loop.py DEFAULTS; set here only to override. See analysis/l5/L5_SHADOW_ARCHITECTURE.md for the meaning of each threshold.
